clue.text: Group of canons taking time for quiet gossip

indicators.note: the group of canons takes in a new letter, signalling a swap
one letter stands in place of the other, so the time letter replaces the quiet letter

parts.note: a cathedral's canons together form its chapter
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A body of cathedral clergy pauses for quiet small talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking time for quiet' means T replaces P in CHAPTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: idle, rapid talk is gossip or prattle.

clue.text: Post office leaves fleet of vehicles for Noel

indicators.note: the abbreviation departs, so it is removed

parts.note: a car pool is a shared fleet of vehicles

explanation.surface: A post office van departs the depot to deliver at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: Noel is an old word for a Christmas song, a seasonal hymn.

clue.text: Bishop involved in a program to search for friar

indicators.note: the bishop letter is set inside the other pieces

parts.note: a bot is a program that crawls the web searching
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop uses a search program to track down a friar.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose synonym: the head of an abbey of monks, a religious brother like a friar.

clue.text: Tribute about husband beginning to rest on the far side

indicators.note: the tribute goes around the husband letter

parts.note: a tithe is a tenth paid as tribute

indicators.note: only the first letter of rest is taken

explanation.surface: A payment covers a husband who starts relaxing across the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic adjective: the thither bank of a river is the one over there, the far side.

clue.text: Possibility of two knights making a comeback

indicators.note: coming back means the letters read in reverse

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for knight
Sir is the title given to a knight

explanation.surface: A pair of knights might return to the fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a chance of loss or danger is a possibility of harm.

clue.text: Baker's product unwrapped and put in natural sweet

indicators.note: the trimmed word is placed inside the abbreviation for natural
taking off the outer covering means losing the first and last letters of the baker's product

parts.note: dough is what a baker makes bread from

explanation.surface: A baker's goods are unpacked and dropped into a natural confection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unwrapped' strips the outer letters, leaving OUGH; 'Baker's product' looks like the definition but the sweet is defined at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a chewy confection of nuts, honey and egg white is a type of sweet.

clue.text: Not a single person's beginning to sing in services

parts.note: none means not a single person, and the 's is read as is

indicators.note: the first letter of sing is taken

explanation.surface: Nobody starts singing during church services.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun: the ninth-hour daily office of prayer in the church is a set of services.

clue.text: Excited father embraces sailor docked in Swedish city

parts.note: being up means excited or in high spirits

indicators.note: the father word wraps around the shortened sailor

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father

indicators.note: cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: an old salt is a seasoned sailor

explanation.surface: An excited dad hugs a seaman whose ship has berthed in Sweden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'docked' trims SALT to SAL, which PA 'embraces'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an ancient university town north of Stockholm is a Swedish city.

clue.text: Broken bail, one excuse for not being there

indicators.note: a broken thing is disordered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone who skipped bail offers a reason they were elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a plea that one was elsewhere when a crime happened.

clue.text: Arab bigot imprisons spiritual leader

indicators.note: the phrase locks the letters up inside itself, signalling a hidden word

explanation.surface: A prejudiced Arab locks up a religious figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jewish religious teacher and leader of a congregation is a spiritual guide.

clue.text: Sketch small animal returning with little relative

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

indicators.note: coming back means the animal is read backwards

parts.note: a pony is a small horse
sis is a short, informal word for sister

explanation.surface: Someone draws a little creature coming home with a young family member.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an outline or brief summary is a sketch of a larger work.

clue.text: Settled upon Greek character's fruit

parts.note: a bird that has lit on a branch has settled upon it
chi is the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek figure's fruit has come to rest somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Variant spelling of lychee, a sweet Chinese fruit with white flesh.

clue.text: Stab leading writer

parts.note: to have a stab is to make an attempt, an essay
1ST, read as letters IST, means first or leading

explanation.surface: A knife attack on a prominent author.
explanation.walkthrough: The 1 of 1ST is read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an author of short prose compositions is a kind of writer.

clue.text: General course for singer

definitions.meaning: the overall drift or gist of something
a high male voice in a choir

explanation.definitionFit: One word means both the general drift of something and a high male voice.

clue.text: What a farrier may do to get away we hear

indicators.note: the word is spoken, so it is a sound-alike

parts.note: shoo is a call telling an animal to get away

explanation.surface: A blacksmith's job is said to be shooing animals away.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb: a farrier fits iron plates to horses' hooves, so this is the farrier's task.

clue.text: I may leave broken urinal for use on the moon

indicators.note: a broken object is in pieces, so the letters are rearranged
the letter I departs, so it is removed from the rearranged letters

explanation.surface: A smashed toilet is jokingly offered for astronauts.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange URINAL and drop the I ('may leave') to leave LUNAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective sense: equipment designed for the moon is described as lunar, as in a lunar module.

clue.text: Ship — one acquired by old transport company

indicators.note: the railway takes the numeral into itself

parts.note: LNER was the London and North Eastern Railway
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A vessel bought by a former haulage firm.
explanation.walkthrough: The LNER was one of Britain's big four railway companies before 1948.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a large passenger vessel on a regular route is a ship.

clue.text: Sleep with American in New Providence

indicators.note: the American letter goes inside the initials

parts.note: the initials of New Providence, the Bahamas island, are NP

explanation.surface: A Yank dozes on a Bahamas island.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a short daytime doze is a sleep.

clue.text: Journalist attending hard working technical event

parts.note: hack is a slang word for a journalist
to be at an event is to attend it
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
a machine that is on is working

explanation.surface: A reporter at a hard-working tech meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a marathon programming session where coders build projects together is a technical event.

clue.text: Gnaw on cold chop

parts.note: C is the tap abbreviation for cold
to hew is to chop with an axe

explanation.surface: Chewing on a cold lamb chop.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to bite and grind with the teeth is to gnaw.

clue.text: Trendy music — not half

indicators.note: half of the word is left out

parts.note: a rap-based style of music, two words of three letters each

explanation.surface: Fashionable sounds that aren't half bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang synonym: fashionable or cool is hip.

clue.text: Nine popes arranged to see Far Eastern people

indicators.note: the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Nine pontiffs line up to visit people in the Far East.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: Nippon is Japan's own name, so these are the Japanese, a Far Eastern people.

clue.text: Only child fed with milled grain grown without chemicals?

indicators.note: the abbreviation is filled with the rearranged letters

parts.note: OC is the abbreviation for only child

indicators.note: milled grain is ground up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lone child eats ground-up grain raised with no pesticides.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: farm produce raised with no artificial fertiliser or pesticides is labelled organic.

clue.text: Manic games in hospital yard regularly overlooked

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: the games letters go inside the others
every other letter is skipped, keeping the first and third

parts.note: PE is physical education, school games

explanation.surface: Frenzied sports in a hospital courtyard routinely go unnoticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly overlooked' reduces yard to YR; PE goes 'in' H YR.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone over-excited and frantic is manic, informally hyper.

clue.text: Foreign secretary's qualification about bullets

indicators.note: the qualification goes around the ammunition

parts.note: HND is the Higher National Diploma, a British qualification
ammo is short for ammunition such as bullets

explanation.surface: A diplomat's degree concerns munitions.
explanation.walkthrough: Philip Hammond was UK Foreign Secretary 2014-16.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Philip Hammond held the post of British Foreign Secretary.

clue.text: Left and came back to football club?

definitions.meaning: quit a job, gave in one's notice
signed again for the same club, a re-signing

explanation.surface: A footballer quits, then returns to his club.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means both quit a post and, hyphenated, signed a contract again.

clue.text: Arrest group of seven overheard

indicators.note: the word is heard spoken, so a sound-alike

parts.note: the seven seas are a famous group of seven

explanation.surface: Police detain a seven-strong gang, someone eavesdrops.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to take hold of or capture someone is to arrest them.

clue.text: Throw out old short coat

parts.note: ex means former or old

indicators.note: cut short, the last letter goes

parts.note: a pelt is an animal's coat

explanation.surface: Discard an old cropped jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to eject or banish someone is to throw them out.

clue.text: Briefly get better form of drama

indicators.note: cut short, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: to improve is to get better

explanation.surface: A quick way to make theatre better.
explanation.definitionFit: Abbreviation of improvisation: unscripted theatre made up on the spot is a form of drama.

clue.text: Artist's allowed to rear honey badger

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

indicators.note: rear here means toward the back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: let means allowed

explanation.surface: A painter is permitted to raise a honey badger.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: another name for the honey badger, a fierce African mammal.

clue.text: Lead amateur lands unknown part in Chekhov play

indicators.note: lands means gets hold of, so the unknown is caught inside

parts.note: the van is the leading part, the vanguard
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A leading amateur actor wins a role in Chekhov.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lands' puts Y between VAN and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the title character of Uncle Vanya is a role in a Chekhov play.

clue.text: Encourages personalities to welcome good for nothing

indicators.note: the personalities take in a newcomer letter, signalling a swap
the good letter stands in place of the nothing letter

parts.note: egos are one's sense of self, personalities
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Urges big personalities to accept the worthless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'welcome good for nothing': G replaces O in EGOS.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal sense: to egg someone on is to urge or encourage them.

clue.text: Group captures bird leaving South Canadian city

indicators.note: the group holds the trimmed bird within it

parts.note: a wing is a faction or group within a party

indicators.note: the compass letter goes away from the bird

parts.note: a snipe is a wading bird

explanation.surface: A flock catches a bird that flies away from the south toward Canada.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving South' drops the S to give NIPE; 'Group' is a wing in the political sense, not a band of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the capital of Manitoba is a Canadian city.

clue.text: Many a time moderate leader is missing

indicators.note: the first letter, the word's leader, is absent

parts.note: to soften is to moderate or tone down

explanation.surface: A moderate politician's leader keeps going absent.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something happening frequently happens many a time.

clue.text: Poet Laureate tours Eastern state with Independent writer

indicators.note: the outer letters go round the others as a tourist goes round a place

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for Poet Laureate
NC is the postal abbreviation of North Carolina

explanation.surface: The Poet Laureate travels round an eastern state with an independent author.
explanation.walkthrough: NC is North Carolina, a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a writing implement of graphite in wood is a writer in crossword sense.

clue.text: Assistants back installing 51 church seats

indicators.note: the numeral is put inside the turned word
the word is read backwards

parts.note: aides are assistants
LI is 51 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Helpers return to fit out fifty-one pews.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' gives SEDIA; Roman numerals let a number like 51 stand for letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural noun: stone seats for clergy set in the south wall of a chancel are church seats.
